text:
下列「」內的文字讀音何者正確？
       (A)跌「宕」不羈：ㄉㄤˋ            (B)「嚙」臂之交：ㄔˇ
       (C)「褫」奪公權：ㄉ一ˋ            (D)諸父異「爨」：ㄔㄨㄢˋ

下列「」內的文字，何者讀音前後相同？
       (A)「炯」炯有神／「迥」然不同         (B)「謳」歌／「傴」僂提攜
       (C)「揭」其劍／深厲淺「揭」          (D)「鏢」魚船／「瞟」了一眼

下列「」內的文字，何者讀音前後相同？
       (A)風行草「偃」／「揠」苗助長         (B)「矜」寡孤獨／青青子「衿」
       (C)登「鸛」雀樓／醍醐「灌」頂         (D)「揣」摩上意／「惴」惴不安

下列「」內的文字，何者讀音前後相同？
       (A)肆無忌「憚」／「殫」精竭慮         (B)名聞「遐」邇／好整以「暇」
       (C)「怏」怏不樂／「泱」泱大國         (D)灰影「幢」幢／「憧」憬未來

先秦諸子的思想與文章各有其特色，下列何者為主張「守柔」、「無為」思想的重要哲學家？
       (A)孟子     (B)韓非子   (C)老子     (D)墨子

「唐宋八大家」是中國唐代與宋代八位大家的合稱，下列何者被讚稱為：「文起八代之衰，
       道濟天下之溺」？
       (A)蘇軾     (B)柳宗元   (C)韓愈     (D)王安石

下列何者以「吾家藏書一萬卷，集錄三代以來金石遺文一千卷，有琴一張，有棋一局，常置
       酒一壺，以吾一老翁，老於此五物之間，是豈不為六一乎」之語，自稱「六一居士」？
       (A)范仲淹    (B)歐陽脩   (C)宋祁     (D)陸游


                    共同科目(國文、英文) 第 1 頁，共 4 頁          【請翻頁繼續作答】

下列何者為中國最早的白話章回小說？
       (A)杜光庭《虬髯客傳》                                    (B)施耐庵《水滸傳》
       (C)吳承恩《西遊記》                                     (D)羅貫中《三國演義》

《論語：先進》宗廟之事，如會同，端章甫，願為小相焉。其中「章甫」指的是下列何者？
       (A)古代禮帽            (B)代表國家政權的神器
       (C)古代的酒器           (D)古代用來盛祭品的禮器

他鼓動「如簧之舌」，終於說服客戶接受他的提案，其中「如簧之舌」之意為下列何者？
        (A)形容知識豐富，學問廣博     (B)形容人講話滔滔不絕
        (C)形容人話語不多，沉默寡言    (D)形容人好逞口舌之快

下列何者為描寫春夏的景致？
        (A)得斯泉於山谷之間                                    (B)仰而望山，俯而聽泉
        (C)風霜冰雪，刻露清秀                                   (D)掇幽芳而蔭喬木

蘇軾謫居黃州作《赤壁賦》「桂棹兮蘭槳，擊空明兮泝流光。渺渺兮予懷，望美人兮天一方」
        之文句，所要表達之意為下列何者？
        (A)泛舟赤壁的樂趣         (B)感嘆人生之短暫渺小
        (C)內心釋懷之歡喜與曠達通脫之安適 (D)遠謫異鄉、遙念君國

「劉姥姥進大觀園」已經成為一句成語，用來形容下列何者情境？
        (A)平凡的人貢獻平凡的事物     (B)眼界狹小無法接受新事物
        (C)沒見過世面的人開了眼界     (D)滄海桑田世事多變難預料

有關「新月詩派」的說明，下列何者有誤？
        (A)「新月」二字取自泰戈爾的詩集
        (B)作品講究形式整齊和辭藻美麗
        (C)徐志摩、卞之琳可說是新月代表詩人
        (D)為擺脫舊詩的束縛，主張完全的自由，不受任何格律限制

徐志摩《再別康橋》一詩中，「那波光裡的豔影，在我的心頭蕩漾」文句表達的意思為下列
        何者？
        (A)往日的青春美夢終難追憶     (B)柳樹倒映在康河裏的情景，勾起眷戀的感情
        (C)對離別在即感到感傷       (D)象徵自己對未來生活的規劃與期望


    貳、英文：100 %
     【單選題： 40 題，每題 2.5 分，共 100 分；請在『答案卡』題號 16~55 畫記作答。】

What’s the best answer when someone says, “How are things?” to you?
        (A) What things?       (B) Same as usual.   (C) I don’t have a clue. (D) I like them.

Earthquakes are not predictable, but new detectors ____ you to have 10 extra seconds to respond.
        (A) give               (B) allow               (C) let                (D) make

Due to its success in fighting the COVID-19 pandemic, Taiwan is now a ____ for other countries.
        (A) learning subject     (B) object to copy   (C) standard nation   (D) role model

The company was founded four decades ago; in other words, it has been in operation for ____.
        (A) 40 years        (B) 40 months           (C) 80 years             (D) 80 months

Taiwan ____ approximately 400 kilometers from north to south.
        (A) measures         (B) longs              (C) has                   (D) goes to

                                  共同科目(國文、英文) 第 2 頁，共 4 頁

Which is the most appropriate response to “Why aren’t you going to lunch with us?”?
        (A) I’m not friends.                         (B) I had a late breakfast.
        (C) Is it a question?                        (D) It’s my problem.

Possessing a skill can be more ____ than having a pretty diploma sometimes.
        (A) better              (B) valuable           (C) impressed          (D) convenient

Cathy is extremely ____ because she has exercised regularly for years.
        (A) fit                (B) satisfaction       (C) likable              (D) suitable

Junk food is unhealthy, but it is usually quite ____ ; that’s why a lot of people like it.
        (A) good taste          (B) smells wonderful (C) flavorful                  (D) attractive

Tom and Jerry are identical twins and it’s hard to ____ between them.
        (A) tell the difference (B) separate             (C) know who         (D) confirm the identity

It’s difficult to achieve the goal of same work same pay between men and women although ____ is a
        government policy.
        (A) salary fairness        (B) equal wages        (C) gender equality (D) equality for all

Talk to the ____ if you have any question about the amount of pay you received last week.
        (A) chairperson         (B) chief secretary    (C) accounting office (D) personal office

“Do you have minute? I need to ____ you.”
        (A) hear a story from (B) tell a lie to           (C) have a chat with     (D) play some music with

You have to ____ if you want to play the game.
        (A) enjoy the atmosphere                       (B) follow the rules
        (C) know the results                           (D) take the money

“There is no need to ____ ; the movie already started half hour ago.”
        (A) arrive             (B) rush                 (C) race                   (D) choose

Jack admitted that he should have listened to you. It means
        (A) He didn’t hear you.                         (B) You didn’t speak.
        (C) He didn’t listen to you.                    (D) You had told him.

“We’re celebrating Jimmy’s birthday this Friday. He’s ____ 26.”
        (A) turning           (B) been                 (C) gone to                 (D) arrived

Mark is an interesting person and people like to be ____ him.
        (A) besides             (B) as                  (C) around                 (D) for

Jay has trouble managing his money and he always ____ at the end of the month.
        (A) runs out of money (B) uses cash          (C) in need of money (D) has to lend money

Matthew and Tony are buddies. They have known each other ____ childhood.
        (A) from              (B) since            (C) in                  (D) during

Taiwan Power Company is a ____ company under the Ministry of Economic Affairs.
        (A) private        (B) state-owned       (C) electric            (D) publicity

Many sports events are held without ____ because of the pandemic.
        (A) guests             (B) tickets            (C) spectators               (D) people

Gary spends three hours ____ between home and work each day, but he doesn’t mind.
        (A) riding             (B) coming           (C) commuting          (D) transporting

Ken is really a good ____ although he doesn’t seem to have a lot of muscles.
        (A) athlete             (B) cook               (C) game player        (D) gulf player
                                    共同科目(國文、英文) 第 3 頁，共 4 頁                                          【請翻頁繼續作答】

“You’d better hurry if you want to ____. It leaves in half hour.”
        (A) get the airplane    (B) meet the bus        (C) take the taxi          (D) catch the train

The weather has been ____. Sometimes the temperature drops ten degrees in one day.
        (A) inconvenient      (B) unbalanced        (C) inconsistent        (D) unstable

Some people are addicted to ____ and they upload several posts everyday.
        (A) internet          (B) social media        (C) intranet           (D) blogs

It’s impossible to ____ fashion because new models come out so quickly.
        (A) keep up with        (B) pay attention to  (C) focus on           (D) hold on to

Norma’s eyes are all red and swollen; she ____ all night because of not passing the test.
        (A) has cried           (B) must cry           (C) cries                (D) must have cried

“Look at all the dark clouds coming in. It ____ rain.”
        (A) will seem to         (B) will like to       (C) must to                (D) is about to

Taipei 101 ____ the tallest building in the world, but it is still an important landmark in the city.
        (A) has been            (B) used to be           (C) is                     (D) is once

”Jake didn’t ____, so the teacher thought he was not interested in the class.”
        (A) sign up             (B) write down         (C) turn in               (D) call out

No motor vehicles are allowed to enter the pedestrian zone. What is a pedestrian?
        (A) a person           (B) a walker            (C) a passerby          (D) a bicycle rider

Children learn to speak by ____ their older family members.
        (A) learning            (B) studying            (C) imitating              (D) seeing

Which one is the closest to “find out” in meaning?
        (A) learn about        (B) identify             (C) look for               (D) uncover

My best friend’s father wanted to ____ me a job, but I said no to him.
        (A) provide             (B) supply             (C) suggest             (D) offer

The customer who made the complaint accepted my explanation without ____ questions.
        (A) further         (B) answering           (C) worst             (D) little

By ____ garbage, we can reduce the amount of garbage put into our environment.
        (A) keeping           (B) giving away        (C) hiding              (D) sorting

The workers have been instructed to follow the SOP. “SOP” stands for
        (A) simple operation process                   (B) single operational plan
        (C) standard operating procedure               (D) singular operative progress

Heather is a ____ person. She doesn’t talk much.
        (A) talkative          (B) mute                (C) speechless              (D) quiet




                                    共同科目(國文、英文) 第 4 頁，共 4 頁
